title: anthemis cretica subsp. alpina
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Chamomile, is a subspecies of the Anthemis cretica plant, a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. It is known for its soothing and calming effects, which can be attributed to its various health benefits, including the ability to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Chamomile include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, menstrual cramps, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies.
